citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:44 PM on August
13, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the door of the facility and calling on the phone.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Michael Tygart, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
